name: Milli Featherwhistle
summary: At Steelgrill's Depot, Milli Featherwhistle builds and maintains mechanostriders for Gnomeregan's displaced people. She sells these clockwork mounts to her kin and to trusted allies among the exiles.

sections.title: Master of Mechanostriders
sections.body: Just east of Kharanos, Milli works outdoors in Dun Morogh's biting chill. She tunes each mount's gears, pistons, and balancing gyros to carry riders across the snowy crags. Dwarves and night elves favor living mounts. For Gnomeregan's displaced people, Milli's clockwork steeds meet a different need.

sections.title: Legacy of Mekkatorque
sections.body: Milli follows the blueprints first drawn by High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque. She has improved each mechanostrider's performance by lightening its chassis and refining its exhaust vents. Yet she keeps to the High Tinker's original designs. Her work carries gnomish ambition forward, even in exile.

faq.answer: Milli is Gnomeregan's primary mechanostrider breeder and engineer. At Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh, she builds and sells clockwork mounts to eligible riders.

faq.q: Where can I find Milli Featherwhistle?
faq.answer: Milli works at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh, a short walk east along the road from Kharanos.

faq.q: Who is allowed to purchase mounts from her?
faq.answer: Gnomish adventurers can buy Milli's creations directly. Riders of other Alliance races must earn her utmost trust and exalted standing with the Gnomeregan Exiles before she entrusts them with a mechanostrider.
Milli builds each mechanostrider herself from High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque's blueprints. She has improved the engines and balance.

faq.q: What mount varieties does she offer?
faq.answer: Milli offers standard mechanostriders with unpainted, blue, green, and red frames. She also offers swift models finished in white, green, and yellow.

faq.q: Why is she working out in the snow at Steelgrill's Depot?
aliases: why is milli in dun morogh
faq.answer: After a radioactive catastrophe and a trogg invasion drove the gnomes from Gnomeregan, refugees gathered wherever they could. Steelgrill's Depot outside Kharanos became a natural staging hub, where they could test vehicles and maintain machinery alongside dwarven engineers.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can see Milli carry forward High Tinker Mekkatorque's technological genius. She is your people's premier mount engineer, still at work in exile from your subterranean home.
Milli's mechanostriders are the pinnacle of gnomish locomotion. They have gyroscopic balance units and high-torque mechanical limbs.
As an Alliance hero, you can seek out Milli after earning the utmost respect of the Gnomeregan Exiles. Then you can command one of Azeroth's swiftest mechanical mounts.
